documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Of Board Meeting
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Shaily Engineering Plastics reported its Q1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong growth in the Healthcare segment driven by pen injectors for GLP-1 and chronic therapies. Consolidated revenue grew 14% year-on-year to INR281 crores, while EBITDA rose 18% to INR83 crores and PAT increased by 17% to INR48 crores. Management noted that the global operating environment remained challenging due to geopolitical tensions and freight costs, but remains confident about exceeding its annual pen volume guidance of 36 million units. The company also made strategic progress in the Industrial and Consumer Electronics segments, alongside new healthcare device developments. guidance.claim: Management stated that the company should be able to go beyond the 36 million pen guidance for the full year.
guidance.quote: Short answer is we should be.

guidance.claim: The company targets a combined capacity of 40 million to 42 million pens from the two new lines by the end of the year.
guidance.quote: See, what our target is that by the end of the year, both lines should be able to produce at 65 to 67 parts per minute effectively, which gives us a combined capacity of both these 2 new lines of around 40 million to 42 million pens combined.

guidance.claim: Management targets 35 million to 40 million pens from the new capacity to be in supply by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: By FY28, I think what we're targeting is 35 million to 40 million pens from that capacity should more or less be in supply by end of FY28.

guidance.claim: The company targets roughly 36 million pen supplies for the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: I think Amit mentioned 36 million, right, Amit?

demand_outlook.claim: The Consumer segment reported softer demand in home furnishings across Europe and the United States.
demand_outlook.quote: Performance reflected softer demand in home furnishings across Europe and United States, our largest export markets for the business.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted weaker market demand for home furnishings across Europe and USA.
demand_outlook.quote: Weaker Market Demand for Home Furnishings across Europe & USA

demand_outlook.claim: Customers in Canada have asked for more product following the initial two launches.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes. Given only 2 launches in Canada, we are asked for more product.

demand_outlook.claim: The consumer segment de-grew in Q4 26 due to weaker market demand for home furnishings across Europe and the U.S.
demand_outlook.quote: The Consumer segment unfortunately de-grew in Q4 '26, primarily reflecting weaker market demand for home furnishings across Europe and the U.S., our 2 largest export markets for this vertical.

capex_expansion.claim: An additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by the end of September.
capex_expansion.quote: As committed earlier, our additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by end of September, taking our total installed pen injector capacity to approximately 75 million pens per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: Semiconductor trays investment is initially looked at around INR5 crores in the existing facility.
capex_expansion.quote: Semiconductor Trays, I think we have mentioned that we are looking at investing about INR5 crores in our existing facility, which would meet initial requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: For Consumer Electronics, an investment of INR80 crores to INR100 crores is planned for the new facility down south.
capex_expansion.quote: On Consumer Electronics, again, we have said that once we set up a plant down south, we would be looking at an investment of somewhere between INR80 crores to INR100 crores in that facility.

capex_expansion.claim: An additional 25 million capacity coming in by July or August is purely for Semaglutide for global markets.
capex_expansion.quote: The additional 25 million that will come in by July, August is purely for Semaglutide, which will be again used for the global markets where the product is launched.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved by 120 bps year-on-year to 29.7% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR83 crores from INR70 crores, reflecting a growth of 18%, while EBITDA margin improved by 120 bps to 29.7%.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin improved by 40 basis points year-on-year to 17.1% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin improved to 17.1%, an expansion of 40 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects gross margin to return to normalized levels by quarter 3.
margins_costs.quote: We expect that the gross margin would come back to normalized level by quarter 3.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA stood at INR69 crores with an EBITDA margin of 29.3%, an increase of 420 bps over Q4 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR69 crores as compared to INR55 crores in Q4 FY '25 a growth of 27% year on year. EBITDA margin stood at 29.3%, an increase of 420 bps Q4 FY '25.

margins_costs.claim: FY26 consolidated EBITDA stood at INR288 crores with an EBITDA margin of 29.0%, reflecting a 630 bps increase over FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR288 crores as compared to INR178 crores during FY '25, reflecting a growth of 61% on a Y-o-Y basis. EBITDA margins stood at 29.0%, an increase of 630 bps over FY '25.

orders_capacity.claim: Total installed pen injector capacity is approximately 50 million pens per annum prior to the September expansion.
orders_capacity.quote: As committed earlier, our additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by end of September, taking our total installed pen injector capacity to approximately 75 million pens per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Machine utilization improved to 50.2% during Q1 FY27 compared with 48.7% in Q1 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Machine utilization improved to 50.2% during Q1 FY27 compared with 48.7% in Q1 FY26, reflecting a gradual improvement in capacity utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: Machine utilization improved to 47.6% in FY26 compared to 42.2% in the previous year.
orders_capacity.quote: Machine utilization improved to 47.6% in FY '26 compared to 42.2% last year.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports contributed around 68% of total revenue in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Exports continue to remain strong and contributed around 68% of our revenue in FY '26.

orders_capacity.claim: The 25 million capacity installed in March is running at roughly 45% operational efficiency.
orders_capacity.quote: The 25 million capacity that we installed in March is currently running at roughly 45% utilization, and not utilization, at operational efficiency.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors approved an enabling resolution to raise up to INR500 crores as an annual affair to maintain financial flexibility.
capital_allocation.quote: Reflecting the confidence in Shaily's next phase of growth and the multiple new opportunities ahead of us, the Board of Directors have approved an enabling resolution to raise up to INR500 crores. I would like to clarify that this is intended to be an annual affair.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt to equity stood at 0.3x and the fixed asset turnover ratio stood at 1.7x as on 31st March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt to equity stood at 0.3x and our fixed asset turnover ratio stood at 1.7x as on 31st March 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global operating environment remained challenging due to geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia impacting supply chains and commodity markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global operating environment remained challenging in the quarter with continued uncertainty arising from the geopolitical situation in West Asia and its wider impact on supply chain as well as commodity markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter witnessed heightened geopolitical uncertainty from global trade tensions impacting freight movement, supply chain, and input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter has witnessed heightened geopolitical uncertainty, particularly due to ongoing tensions across global trade corridors, which impacted freight movement, supply chain and input cost dynamics.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues led to raw material price inflation and selective logistical disruptions for the plastics and polymer industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: For the plastics and polymer industry, this translated into raw material price inflation and selective logistical disruptions across certain export routes.

management_commitments.claim: The additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by the end of September.
management_commitments.quote: As committed earlier, our additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by end of September, taking our total installed pen injector capacity to approximately 75 million pens per annum.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial sales for the Abu Dhabi plant are expected to start by the end of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The plant is supposed to start selling by end of FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets getting to the $10 million revenue milestone for Consumer Electronics within 30 months.
management_commitments.quote: We think we can get to that number within 30 months.

management_commitments.claim: Supplies for the semiconductor tray customer will start in Quarter 4 of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Quarter 4 of the current financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Commercialization of the eye-applicator has been factored into the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: And we have factored the commercialization of the eye-applicator in the current financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
